title: High-accuracy thrust measurements of the EMDrive and elimination of false-positive effects
claim: the recorded quote was verbatim on the opened page
quote: Page body, setup section: "Our cavity is based on the same geometry as the one used by White et al. [[3](/article/10.1007/s12567-021-00385-1#ref-CR3)] to compare with peer-reviewed results.
